name: Natural gas; combusted in industrial equipment
description: Provides an estimated national mix of industrial natural gas combustion equipment (engines and turbines, not boilers) in the US.

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Mix year 2017, based on the equipment inventory vintage used in an assessment of stationary combustion technology in the US (Schoeneberger et al. 2022) and related national inventory data.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Based on US facility reported data.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: US average mix of industrial natural gas equipment (not boilers). Shares: 50 percent reciprocating engines (uncontrolled) and 50 percent turbines (uncontrolled).
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Mix of NETL industrial reciprocating engine and turbine unit processes (uncontrolled). Boilers, oil and gas field equipment, and mobile sources are excluded.
processDocumentation.restrictionsDescription: All information can be accessed by everybody.
